hooks.command: GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git fetch -q 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null); if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Git: origin has $n new commit(s) not in your local branch. Tell the user and pull (merge) before working:"; git log --format='  %h %an: %s' HEAD..@{u} | head -10; else echo 'Git: up to date with origin.'; fi; exit 0
